HOK is a collective of future-forward thinkers and designers who are driven to face the critical challenges of our time. We are dedicated to improving people's lives, serving our clients and healing the planet. Together, we cultivate a culture of design excellence at the confluence of art and science, blending the power of creative expression with a clear sense of purpose.

Licensed Architect who exercises independent judgment in evaluation, selection, and use of standard techniques, and solves problems when encountered.

Leadership

Leads team in planning work and developing solutions to technical and design detail problems.
Responsible for establishing, maintaining and adherence to project budget and schedule.
Supervises preparation of technical drawings by other less senior level architects or professionals.
Prepares client presentations and presents design concepts and drawings.
Ensures that construction detail documentation conforms to QA/QC and HOK Best Practice standards.
Incorporates Integrated Sustainable Design solutions into projects.
Mentors and directs the work of less experienced staff, may participate in professional development; reviews and “Lessons Learned” sessions.
Fosters and maintains a collaborative professional working relationship with the Project Leadership Team
Assures the overall strategy for producing documents and organizing data will be followed. This includes incorporating elements in a Building Information Model (BIM) or other 3D model.
Assures HOK document standards are met and archives documents appropriately.
Sets up project team software parameters and manages standards.
Takes personal responsibility for fostering a green workplace through sustainable work practices.

Client Interface

Communicates with client representatives to verify design requirements and specifications, progress reviews and delivery of final presentation.

Teamwork

Analyzes and develops approaches to the creation and modification of architectural documents, elevations, sections, details, specifications, etc. ensuring the incorporation of design intent.
Responsible for technical resolution and coordination for a defined portion of a project.
Develops solutions to design problems.
Corrects and updates, making minor adaptations and modifications, to complete working design documents.
Attends on-site visits, field reviews and project meetings and documents appropriately. Prepares, coordinates and reviews the schedules, submission of shop drawings and samples.
Responsible for communication with other disciplines, vendors, and contractors to ensure incorporation of all information into project requirements and provide support as necessary.
Performs product research; assists project designers with material selection and system research.
Coordinates with project managers, clients, public agencies, consultants and contractors to incorporate engineering systems, respond to requests for information, clarifications, and modifications, and obtain approvals, negotiations and adjusting scope of services.
Writes reports and memos to consultants and vendors to issue changes and track resolutions.
Reviews completed reports, plans, estimates and calculations for coordination.
Participates in team meetings to help resolve project issues, coordination with other disciplines, schedule adherence, and technical issues.
Participates in project reviews regarding project costs, budgets and adherence to schedule.
Communicates in a clear, concise, and professional manner at all times, both verbally and in writing and will have regular interface with clients.
Applies proper QA/QC methods throughout project. May lead this effort.
Provides support to all team members for specific market, discipline, or other area of expertise.
May provide assistance in connection with expertise in particular building types, component, material, element, or building code.
May assist team in construction administration document management.
May assist Project Manager with defining project work plans.
Prepares meeting minutes for consultant coordination meetings.

Bachelor’s degree in architecture or equivalent in education or experience required. Master’s degree preferred.
5 plus years’ experience.
Licensed Architect with current registration in your region required, if licensure is offered in your region.

s.h: LEED accreditation or Green Associate preferred.
s.t:
Many of our roles require the use of specific software. Please refer to the Required and Preferred Software & Skills for details.

HOK invests in its people and communities, supporting both personal and professional growth through every stage of life. At HOK you’ll have a hybrid work environment, 10 paid holidays (including 2 floating holidays) and a minimum of 4 weeks of paid time off with a cash out option.

HOK offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, free mental wellness resources, life and AD&D coverage and short and long-term disability benefits. HOK supports your growing family by offering 4 weeks of paid parental leave and fertility coverage.

HOK helps to fund your future financial needs with matching contributions to our 401(K) plan which includes a well-rounded investment menu as well as free guidance on retirement planning.

Wherever you are in your career, HOK provides opportunities to learn, develop and utilize your skills. Continued learning is promoted through financial support and study prep for licensure exams, CEU credit opportunities, mentorship programs, and paid professional memberships. To learn more about designing your career with HOK, explore our current job openings.

HOK is an EOE, including disability/vets.

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, education and location. The reasonably expected salary range for this position is $85,000 to $115,000. Other compensation may include a discretionary bonus.

Benthem Crouwel Architects ontwerpt innovatieve, flexibele en efficiënte gebouwen in binnen- en buitenland. Van stations tot musea, van kantoren tot tiny houses: alle ontwerpen brengen economische, sociale en ecologische aspecten in balans — met bijzondere aandacht voor innovatie en duurzaamheid. Voorbeelden, zoals Rotterdam Centraal Station en Museum Arnhem, vind je op de pagina Projects.

Naar wie we op zoek zijn

Voor ons bureau in Diemen zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een Architect. Een creatieve, zelfstandige collega die gepassioneerd aan de slag wil om samen met teamgenoten tot excellente resultaten te komen. Met circa vijf jaar ervaring hebben de verschillende fases van het ontwerpproces geen geheimen meer voor je. Je bent klaar voor een volgende stap, om bij een internationaal gerenommeerd bureau aan uitdagende en prestigieuze projecten en aanbestedingen te werken.

Wat we verwachten

Of het nu gaat om het ontwerpproces of het coachen van teamleden, als Architect til je onze projecten naar een hoger niveau. Je bent betrokken bij elke fase en vormt een belangrijke toegevoegde waarde voor de opdrachtgever. Met minstens vijf jaar ervaring ben je in staat om zelfstandig aan uitdagende opdrachten te werken.

Je bewaakt de ontwerpvisie zowel intern als extern. Als flexibele teamspeler schakel je moeiteloos tussen verschillende communicatiestijlen. We gaan ervan uit dat je ervaring hebt met Revit en over voldoende BIM-vaardigheden beschikt.

Wat we bieden

Salariëring vindt plaats op basis van de Architecten CAO en de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn marktconform. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om je carrièrepad verder vorm te geven. Vanuit onze locatie in Diemen werken we hier met vijftig collega’s in een cultuur van collegialiteit, behulpzaamheid en wederzijds respect. Het tonen van initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd. Communicatielijnen zijn kort en de sfeer is informeel, maar ook gedreven.

Hoe je kunt solliciteren

Als deze uitdaging je aanspreekt en past bij je ervaring en ambitie, kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten. Sollicitaties zijn welkom via de knop hieronder. We ontvangen graag je CV en portfolio met visuele voorbeelden zoals ontwerpen en technische tekeningen. In plaats van een motivatiebrief kun je ook onderstaande vragen beantwoorden.

De sluitingsdatum voor deze vacature is 16 augustus 2026. Na deze datum zullen we reageren. De startdatum van de functie is in overleg.

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met onze HR-adviseur Sabine Lindner via hr@benthemcrouwel.nl of 020 642 0105.

We’re growing! Following a series of exciting new wins across the residential, commercial and hospitality sectors, we are expanding our design team and we’re looking for talented, curious and passionate Part 3 qualified Architects with an interest in blurring the boundaries between architecture and interior design.

At Conran and Partners, you’ll have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of sectors, scales and geographies – from high-end residential and BTR in London to five-star hotels in Asia to mixed use projects in the Middle East – collaborating with a creative international team of architects and interior designers.

With studios in London and Hong Kong, Conran and Partners is a RIBA Chartered practice with a world-class reputation for thoughtful, progressive and sustainable design.

Our collaborative, research-led process balances creativity and practicality, combining a valuable design legacy with a forward-thinking vision to deliver bold, inspiring spaces that enrich people’s lives and respond sensitively to diverse contexts, typologies and global locations.

We are looking for Part 3 qualified architects with proven experience and strong design sensibilities that sit well with our studio ethos. The role involves supporting new projects across a range of typologies, working on interior architecture, adaptive re-use as well as new-build projects, in the UK and abroad. The ideal candidate will have in the region of one to two years of post-qualification experience, alongside a strong creative drive and sound technical understanding.

s.t:
Experience collaborating within teams delivering world-class architecture and interior architecture in the UK. (Previous international experience is a benefit, though not essential).
A strong aptitude for designing across the inside and outside of buildings, including new-build fit-out.
An interest in working in mixed discipline teams of architects and interior designers across different typologies, for projects in the UK and abroad.
Strong creative contribution and ability to present ideas to the senior teams clearly and concisely, to be demonstrated through a well-presented CV and portfolio of work.
Confident delivery of drawings with an ability to deliver work to a high level of detail.
Strong knowledge and practical experience of Revit essential (AutoCAD a benefit).
Excellent communication and presentation skills with an eye for detail.
An enthusiastic, collaborative, and innovative approach.
Creative and technical skills with strong hand drawing, as well as digital skills to encourage creative agility through all stages of work.
A team player who is adaptable and enthusiastic to further develop their career in a well-respected studio.

This is a full-time position. All candidates should be eligible to work in the UK.

Conran and Partners is an equal opportunities employer and offers the opportunity for growth. We recognise the need for more diversity in our industry and encourage applicants from under-represented backgrounds to apply. Other benefits include flexible working.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS: To qualify for this position, you MUST meet all of the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Basic Requirements 808: Degree: architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related disciplines of which at least (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, and (2) 6 semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

(Transcripts must be submitted with your application.) OR Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the arts and sciences underlying professional architecture, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the architectural principles, methods, and techniques and their applications to the design and construction or improvement of buildings.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by at least one of the following (Transcripts must be submitted with your application.): Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The curriculum for a degree in either architecture or architectural engineering covers function, esthetics, site, structure, economics, mechanical-electrical, and other engineering problems related to the design and construction of buildings primarily (but not exclusively) intended to house human activities.

Experience: An applicant lacking a degree in architecture must have had l year of experience in an architect's office or in architectural work for each year short of graduation from a program of study in architecture. In the absence of college courses, 5 years of such experience is required.

This experience must have demonstrated that the applicant has acquired a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional architecture. In addition to the basic requirements above, applicants must demonstrate minimum qualifying specialized experience.

MINIMUM QUALIFYING SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

To be creditable, an applicant's one full year of specialized experience must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for successful job performance.

GS-12: In order to qualify for this position at the GS-12 level, your resume must clearly demonstrate that you have one full year of the minimum qualifying specialized experience comparable in difficulty and responsibility to at least the GS-11 level in the federal service.

Examples of the minimum qualifying specialized experience equal to the GS-11 level include performing the following types of tasks on a regular and recurring basis: Designing and developing the construction drawings and specifications for engineering and/or architectural systems using industry standard software (e.g.

AutoCAD, Revit, ArcGIS, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite).; Managing or leading significant phases construction projects or complex architectural projects such as multi-story office buildings, industrial facilities, or other large structures, including new construction, repair, renovation, or restoration; Applying architectural and related engineering concepts (e.g., structural, civil, or mechanical systems) to solve a variety of design and construction problems, adapt standards, or develop innovative solutions; and Evaluating architectural planning projects for technical validity, feasibility, and preparing clear analytical or design reports.

Applicants whose resumes clearly demonstrate the required minimum qualifying specialized experience will be evaluated based on the occupational assessment competencies listed below.

A COMPETENCY is defined as a measurable pattern of knowledge, skills, abilities, behaviors, and other characteristics that an individual needs to perform work roles or occupational functions.

Architecture - Knowledge of the concepts, principles, theories, and practices used in the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of buildings or other structures, taking into consideration aesthetic and functional concerns.

Civil Engineering- Knowledge of the concepts, principles, theories, and methods required to plan, design, construct, operate, and maintain facilities such as buildings, transportation systems, water and sanitary systems, and other public works systems.

Enterprise Architecture- Knowledge of principles, concepts, and methods of enterprise architecture to align information technology (IT) strategy, plans, and systems with the mission, goals, structure, and processes of the organization General Engineering- Knowledge of the concepts, principles, and theories of engineering and their practical applications NOTE: Education can be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Das Gebiet «Im Funken» in Zofingen wird zu einem dichten und vielfältigen Stadtquartier mit gemischten Nutzungen entwickelt. Historische Gebäude prägen zusammen mit neuer, klassisch und neo-renaissance-inspirierter Architektur die Identität des Quartiers, während Strassen, Plätze, Höfe und Wege eine Verbindung zur nahegelegenen Altstadt schaffen.

Wir freuen uns, dass die Bauarbeiten am WDR-Filmhaus in Köln sich dem Ende zuneigen.

Am und um den Appellhofplatz, einem historisch bedeutsamen Ort der Kölner Altstadt nahe dem Dom und Hauptbahnhof, ist der Westdeutsche Rundfunk in mehreren Gebäuden beheimatet. Das Filmhaus, ursprünglich ein Bau aus den 70er-Jahren, wird in ein Cross-mediales Haus transformiert. Das zentrale Element bildet eine, als kontinuierliche Kaskade gedachte Treppe, die durch einen Einschnitt in den Bestand entsteht. Sie ermöglicht Sichtbezüge und fördert die Kommunikation zwischen den Geschossen.

Die Fotografen Maris Mezulis und Rory Gardiner haben das Gebäude im Sommer und Herbst 2025 besucht und dokumentiert.

At Davis Partnership Architects, we believe in creating innovative, sustainable, and aesthetically beautiful spaces that enrich lives. We are a dynamic, award-winning firm with a great team and creative environment that offers integrated services (architecture, landscape architecture, interior design, and wayfinding and experiential design) from our studio in the RiNo neighborhood of downtown Denver.

We are looking for a creative, talented, and collaborative senior-level Healthcare Architect or Medical Planner with 10-15 years of experience in institutional healthcare construction who is highly attentive to detail and has strong project and people skills to join our healthcare practice team.

We are looking for someone with experience in Inpatient and Behavioral Health design, Senior Living and Outpatient Clinics. Successful candidates are those who thrive in a team environment and are willing to take on challenges and grow as a professional.

10-15 years of experience in healthcare project types, medical planning, and institutional grade construction.

Completion of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.

Must have experience with Inpatient and Behavioral Health design.

Experience in Senior Living and Outpatient Clinics experience is preferred.

Experience in Revit and Sketch-up is required.

Although many of us are working a hybrid in-office and remote from home schedule, working from Denver is required.

Roles and responsibilities include Client communications and presentation, project team coordination, consultant team coordination, individual task and work assignments, overseeing the work of others, overseeing technical development and documentation, frequent representation of the firm during construction administration.

Compensation is provided on a salaried-basis commensurate with experience and licensure, ranging from $100,000 - $124,000 annually.

If you’re interested in being considered for a position, please post a letter of interest, resume and work sample to our resume management portal found on our Careers Page at Davispartnership.com. No phone calls, please.
Why Davis Partnership?

s.h: We asked our team why they choose Davis. Here is what they said
s.t:
· Company Success: Our employees are proud of the Firm they represent.

· Growth from Within: We prioritize internal advancement, ensuring your 15th year is as transformative as your first.

· Values-Driven Culture: We are a progressive, modern firm deeply involved in the community.

· Inspiring Environment: Work in a light-filled, open studio designed for the same collaboration we provide our clients.

· Holistic Benefits: We offer a generous package because we believe supporting your personal life is the best way to support your professional life.

If you want to create amazing places that inspire and elevate the joy and dignity of where people heal, learn, live, and grow, we’d love to hear from you!

DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group's Nashville Office has an opening for an Architect. We operate within a hybrid work model, supporting flexibility between office time and work from home.

As a key contributor to our design team, you will be responsible for the day-to-day design and technical development of projects. You will coordinate all aspects of project documentation and delivery, working closely with our integrated design team to produce high-quality work while ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgets, and work plans.

As part of our integrated design team, you create buildings that elevate the human experience through design. You will partner directly with the Project Manager to ensure the financial health of the project, the quality of project documents, claim prevention, team collaboration and communication. Additionally, you will lead the cross-functional design disciplines in developing technical solutions.

Our Nashville studio is experiencing exciting growth, creating opportunities to work on purposeful, design-driven projects alongside a passionate and collaborative team. Here, you’ll be empowered to shape meaningful work, build strong relationships, and take your career to the next level in a studio that values creativity, impact, and people.

We are looking for someone who is entrepreneurial and enthusiastic about great design with great people. We are seeking an architect who is a team player and embodies integrity, intelligence, curiosity, and critical thinking.

The right candidate will be a well-rounded design professional who is actively involved in all phases of design across a wide variety of project types, scales, and locations.

Develop creative and technically sound solutions to design challenges, ensuring high standards of design excellence
Coordinate project drawings, specifications, and documentation with the project team, ensuring alignment with design intent and budget
Lead collaboration within project teams, generating innovative design ideas and solutions
Apply advanced architectural concepts to projects, including complex assignments requiring new or improved techniques
Integrate QA/QC procedures and practice standards into project deliverables, resolving any issues
Ensure BIM standards are applied and coordinate with the Project Manager and BIM Manager
Provide technical guidance to less experienced staff, fostering a collaborative learning environment
Meet project deliverable deadlines and manage time effectively to maintain project schedules and work plans
Participate in client presentations and contribute to successful project outcomes

Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (Graduate degree not required unless mandated by local licensure regulations)
Minimum of six years of professional experience in architecture
Professional licensure required; LEED AP and other certifications preferred but not required
Proficient in Revit, Bluebeam, SketchUp, Rendering Software, Microsoft Office Suite, and Adobe Suite
Competent in technical design, with the ability to investigate, evaluate, and recommend solutions that meet client needs
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to multitask and maintain quality standards
Demonstrates initiative, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous learning

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
Pour notre équipe Agentic Automation Platform, nous recherchons des développeurs Mendix / architectes de solution expérimentés (tous genres) qui développent non seulement des solutions techniquement solides, mais assument également des responsabilités dans les projets clients.
Le poste s'adresse à des professionnels Mendix expérimentés souhaitant franchir une étape supplémentaire - vers l'architecture de solution, la responsabilité technique de projet et la collaboration directe avec nos clients.
* **Développement :** Tu conçois, développes et assumes la responsabilité des applications Mendix tout au long du cycle de vie du développement logiciel.
* **Mise en œuvre technique :** Tu assumes la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre technique des projets - de l'analyse des besoins à l'architecture et au modélisation de domaine jusqu'à l'implémentation, les tests et le déploiement.
* **Recherche de solutions :** Tu développes avec nos clients des solutions adaptées et traduis les exigences métier en concepts techniques durables.
* **Conseil :** Tu conseilles les clients sur l'architecture, l'utilisation des technologies et les meilleures pratiques dans l'environnement Mendix.
* **Architecture :** Tu assumes de plus en plus de tâches d'architecture et évolues vers un rôle d'architecte de solution ou de lead technique.
* **Responsabilité :** Selon le projet, tu peux agir en tant qu'interlocuteur technique central côté client et assumer la responsabilité de projets ou de flux de projets individuels.
* **Partage des connaissances :** Tu soutiens d'autres développeurs par des conseils techniques, des revues de code et le partage des connaissances.
* **Collaboration :** Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec les analystes métier, chefs de projet, architectes de solution et autres parties prenantes.
* **Développement personnel :** Tu contribues activement au développement de notre compétence Mendix et de nos meilleures pratiques.

* **Formation :** Tu as une formation achevée ou un diplôme dans le domaine de l'informatique, de l'ingénierie logicielle ou dans un domaine comparable.
* **Expérience professionnelle :** Tu disposes de plusieurs années d'expérience dans le développement Mendix et as déjà réalisé de manière autonome des projets exigeants.
* **Certification :** Tu possèdes au minimum une certification Mendix Intermediate, idéalement Advanced ou une qualification comparable.
* **Architecture :** Tu as une solide compréhension de l'architecture logicielle, du modélisation de domaine, des intégrations et des processus modernes de développement logiciel.
* **Communication :** Tu peux non seulement prendre des décisions techniques, mais aussi les expliquer de manière compréhensible aux clients et aux parties prenantes non techniques.
* **Responsabilité :** Tu prends plaisir à assumer des responsabilités et à faire avancer de manière autonome des projets ou des sujets techniques.
* **Orientation client :** Tu possèdes de fortes compétences en communication et coordination et te sens à l'aise dans la collaboration avec les clients.
* **Compréhension des processus :** Tu as une bonne compréhension des processus métier et des exigences fonctionnelles et peux faire le lien entre le métier et la technologie.
* **Méthode de travail :** Tu travailles de manière structurée, orientée solution et autonome et peux rapidement t'adapter à de nouveaux environnements clients.
* **Compétence en IA :** Tu utilises les outils d'IA avec assurance dans ton domaine, évalues les résultats de manière critique et aides les clients et adessi à exploiter le potentiel de l'IA.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Tu communiques très bien en allemand et en anglais ; d'autres langues sont un atout.
* **Disponibilité pour les déplacements :** Tu es prêt à te déplacer pour des projets en Suisse.
Idéalement, tu apportes également
* **Leadership :** Expérience en tant que Technical Lead, Architecte de Solution ou dans une responsabilité comparable
* **Conseil client :** Expérience dans le conseil direct aux clients
* **Intégration :** Expérience avec les intégrations et les API
* **Agilité :** Expérience dans des environnements de projet agiles
* **Certification :** Certification Mendix Advanced
* **Développement :** Intérêt à assumer à terme davantage de responsabilités en architecture et vis-à-vis des clients

s.h: ## DONNEUR DE CHANCES - CE QUI FAIT ADESSO ##
s.t:
Notre promesse : tu te sentiras bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d'égalité - nous vivons l'échange, l'esprit d'équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que toi en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représentent notre sentiment d'appartenance très particulier. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprends et grandis avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d'apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons ton développement continu.
* **Vis un véritable esprit d'équipe :** Des événements communs (par exemple, week-end sportif et le voyage annuel de formation eduCamp), des journées d'accueil, des courses d'entreprise renforcent notre cohésion et te font sentir membre de l'équipe dès le début.
* **Engagement récompensé :** Ton engagement paie - avec des primes pour les recommandations, les présentations, l'encadrement des travaux de fin d'études ainsi que des réductions attractives via notre portail Corporate Benefits.
Notre culture et notre collaboration sont marquées par la reconnaissance, l'appréciation et le soutien mutuel. Cela nous unit - même en télétravail. Le travail à temps partiel est possible sur accord (80-100%). Nous avons été à plusieurs reprises élus parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Suisse !

Notre large offre de formation et un modèle transparent de progression de carrière pour tous garantissent que ton développement ne stagne pas chez nous. Car grandir ensemble et être donneur de chances, c'est inscrit dans notre ADN.

At Giannone Petricone Associates (GPA) we are designing environments inspired by a love of city-making and contemporary urban culture. We are growing and looking to hire architects and designers that will complement our great team of creative individuals and help us rise to the challenges of the next level of exciting projects. Currently, we are seeking an experienced Senior Architect with a passion for master planning and the design and documentation of mixed-use developments.

GPA relies on its senior staff to see the big picture and lead the successful execution of projects by being a leader and dedicated team player, bringing creativity and approaching tasks with ingenuity.

To be the successful candidate you will have a commitment to design excellence and execution and strong skills in the production and co-ordination of contract documents with annotated and dimensioned drawings. You must be able to demonstrate experience ranging from concept design through to contract administration.

You will have the ability to share design ideas, communicate clearly, develop concepts and present unique design proposals. The role is diverse and will involve individual work as well as significant teamwork. A senior staff member is a critical point person who must effectively manage varying workloads while coordinating with team members, clients, contractors, and others.

Lead Architectural Project Manager - Data Centres
Lead Architectural Project Manager - Data Centres

Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At Arkitema, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

Therefore, we are looking for a Lead Architectural Project Manager to join us. In this role, you will work closely with clients, colleagues, and partners to shape and deliver data centre projects from early concept through to design and implementation.

From day one, you will engage directly with clients - leading meetings, guiding decision-making, and driving the delivery of CSA disciplines across projects. You will translate global concepts into locally compliant solutions while structuring teams and workflows to ensure efficient execution.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Lead multidisciplinary design for mission‑critical projects

As Lead Architectural Project Manager you will provide overall design leadership. You will align client requirements, technical disciplines and operational priorities, and help teams navigate complexity without losing sight of what creates value - throughout all project phases from concept to handover.

s.h: Your key responsibilities will be to
s.t:
Lead multidisciplinary design delivery for data centre projects.
Ensure coordinated delivery across a large multidisciplinary project team, including discipline leads and international engineering teams.
Set clear direction, create clarity, and facilitate effective collaboration.
Oversee project financials, reporting to steering committees, and proactive risk management.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you -colleagues, partners and customers. You act respectfully, listen actively and follow through on your commitments. And you remain curious about new perspectives and ways to improve.

s.h: On top of that, you will have
s.t:
A relevant educational background in project management, architecture, engineering or a related field.
Experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
Experience from data centre projects or other large‑scale, mission‑critical facilities.
Experience leading large, multidisciplinary project teams.
Professional proficiency in English – verbal and written.

Work location

s.h: The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia
s.t:
Norway – Oslo, Trondheim or Stavanger.

Sweden – Stockholm or Gothenburg.

Denmark – Copenhagen or Aarhus.

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte on mtgt@COWI.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.arkitema.com and www.cowi.com

A place to work and so much more
At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability.

We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key

We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths.

And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Für die Verstärkung unseres Entwurfsteams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die gestalterisch denkt, pragmatisch handelt und Freude daran hat, Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Fertigstellung zu verantworten.

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen Projekten mit direktem Kontakt zur Bauherrschaft und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns, dass du Entscheidungen mitträgst und mitprägst. Daneben bieten wir gute Sozialleistungen, wie fünf Wochen Ferien und eine jährliche Büroreise.

Als Projektleiter:in arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen. Du leitest Projekte in den SIA-Phasen 3–5 von der Machbarkeitsstudie und dem Entwurf über die Baueingabe bis und mit der Ausführungsplanung.

Du koordinierst Fachplaner, führst Gespräche mit Behörden und Bauherrschaften und sorgst dafür, dass Terminpläne und Kostenvorgaben eingehalten werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Projektmitarbeitenden und unserer Baumanagementabteilung zusammen und pflegst einen regen Austausch mit der Bauleitung.

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Architekturstudium (FH oder ETH) und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektleitung, idealerweise im Schweizer Planungs- und Bewilligungskontext. Du arbeitest präzise, kommunizierst klar und bringst ein gutes Gespür für die Balance zwischen gestalterischem Anspruch und baulicher Umsetzbarkeit mit. Kenntnisse in ArchiCAD sind von Vorteil.

Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, cost optimization, resilience planning, and technical leadership skills.

Strategic thinker with strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands-on technical depth with enterprise-level architectural leadership.

Strong active listening, critical thinking, mentoring, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Comfortable working in fast-paced enterprise environments with multiple priorities, distributed teams, and evolving technology landscapes.

You are the CTO's principal technical partner: the person who defines the target-state architecture, sequences the runway to get there, holds the bar on technical quality, and makes the economics of AI and cloud a first-class design consideration rather than an after-the-fact surprise.
The role is deeply technical and deeply cross-functional. You will spend your time in design reviews and equally in rooms with Product, GTM, customers, the executive leadership team and the board — and you will be expected to be credible and additive in all of them.

Portfolio architecture. Own and lead the overall architectural direction across multiple products, defining the target-state platform architecture and the pragmatic path from where each product is today.
Architecture Review Board. Chair and run the ARB — establishing standards, reference architectures, decision records and review cadence, and making it a forum engineers actively bring work to rather than a gate they route around.
Architecture and design runways. Embed directly in the development process where complex deliverables require an architecture or design runway ahead of execution, and stay engaged through delivery rather than handing off a document.
Customer engagement. Represent Showpad's technology to customers and prospects — architecture, security and AI deep dives, plus the product and commercial context that makes them land with an economic buyer.
Technology transformation. Lead modernization of complex, dated products in the portfolio: assess, sequence, de-risk and drive multi-year transformation without stalling the roadmap.
Staffing and operating models. Recommend staffing and sourcing models to the CTO that are efficient on both cost and execution — including global team topology, build/buy decisions and skill mix.
AI and cloud economics. Establish the practices, guardrails and observability that keep AI inference, AI-assisted development and cloud operating costs predictable and defensible as we scale.
Role model. Set the standard for business-aware technical excellence — engineering judgment that is rigorous about quality and equally rigorous about cost, time-to-value and customer outcome.

Experience
15+ years of industry experience, with substantial depth in B2B SaaS.
Has led architecture and development for large-scale enterprise products — multi-tenant, security- and compliance-sensitive, with demanding enterprise customers.
Deep, demonstrable expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native SaaS architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proven track record working with and through globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.
Experience establishing architecture practices across multi-team engineering orgs (RFCs, ADRs, design reviews).
Has owned and delivered significant technical transformation or modernization inside a matrix organization, with influence rather than direct authority over much of the surface area.
Management experience leading teams of 10–25 people directly, while remaining hands-on and technically current.
Technical Depth
Modern AI architecture. Demonstrated depth designing AI-centric systems that actually shipped in product — not prototypes, pilots or strategy decks.
Generative AI. Deeply conversant and hands-on across the modern GenAI stack: foundation models and model selection, RAG and retrieval architecture, embeddings and vector stores, agentic patterns and tool use, orchestration frameworks, fine-tuning and adaptation, evaluation and guardrails, and latency/quality/cost trade-offs.
Cloud architecture. Expert-level cloud architecture and operations, including infrastructure as code, modern CI/CD and deployment pipelines, containers and orchestration, observability, resilience and multi-region design.
Cost management. Real expertise in the cost side of modern engineering — AI inference and token economics, the cost of AI-assisted development, and cloud operational spend — with a track record of moving unit economics in the right direction.

Experience in B2B SaaS, multi-tenant platforms, or sales enablement / GTM tech.
Background in platform/developer-experience engineering.
Open-source contributions or public technical writing that demonstrates architectural thinking.
Familiarity with security-by-design, SOC 2, and compliance-aware architecture.

s.h: What We're Looking For — Personal Qualities
s.t:
Works seamlessly across Product, Technology and GTM without formal authority, building the trust that makes influence possible.
Constructively collaborative but firm — anchored in a fact-based belief system, willing to hold a position on the evidence and equally willing to change it on better evidence.
Senior-level gravitas and presence, with the judgment and polish to present to the executive leadership team and the board.
Able to express complex technical concepts in a genuinely consumable way, calibrated to the audience — board member, customer executive, product manager or engineer.
Comfortable partnering with a deeply technical CEO and going as far down into the technology underpinnings as the conversation requires.
Why This Role Matters
Two strong companies have become one platform opportunity. The decisions this role makes over the next 24 months — on AI architecture, on modernization sequencing, on how we build and what it costs to run — will shape Showpad's product for the next decade. It is an unusually direct line between architectural craft and company outcome.
Showpad is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

The duties and responsibilities for an Architect, GS-0808-13, generally include, but are not limited to, the following: * Reviews and approves architectural features of various designs and construction documents. * Determines terms of cost, system capability, customer requirements and available technology for design projects. * Utilizes a Computer-Aided Design and Drafting (CADD) system to prepare drawings, layouts and specifications. * Develops the conceptual designs and criteria needed for complex architectural/engineering projects.
To qualify for the position of Architect, at GS-0808-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Requirement: A.

You must have a degree in architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related discipline of which at least: (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, AND (2) 6 semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

(NOTE: Transcripts MUST be provided.) OR B.

A combination of education and experience - college level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the arts and sciences underlying professional architecture, AND (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the architectural principles, methods, and techniques and their applications to the design and construction or improvement of buildings.

(NOTE: Transcripts MUST be provided.) OR C. 5 years of experience conducting relevant professional work in architects office or in architectural work.

Non-qualifying experience: The following type of experience is not acceptable as professional architectural experience:* Professional Landscape - architecture work consisting mainly of the layout, design, construction, or maintenance of land areas and landscape features, including ground and water forms, vegetation, roads, walks, incidental structures, and other landscape features.* Experience in the application of artistic embellishment to practical design, such as, the decoration of interiors, including the construction, layout, and selection of furniture and furnishings that do not alter the basic architectural design of the interior.* City and community planning work that relates to the broad social and economic growth and development of such community services and facilities as industry, commerce, transportation, streets, utilities, and parks.

You MUST have a current, valid license to practice Architecture in the United states.

(NOTE: A copy of your license MUST be provided.) Specialized Experience: For the GS-13, you must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or equivalent pay band in the Federal service utilizing a CADD system to prepare drawings, layouts and design specifications, applying project management principles, methods, and tools to resolve architectural problems AND applying architectural design, construction and improvement to buildings.

You MUST meet all qualification requirements, including time-in-grade, by the 09/25/2026 of this announcement. Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating.

See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume. After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you.

You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/25/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.
